method: Rendered every page of both booklets with music_pages.py render at 130 dpi and read each ask page in full; zoomed clips with PyMuPDF (160-800 dpi) on every block and every glyph in doubt: bullets at the left margin of each lead-in, the full stop (or none) after each excerpt heading, curly quotes and apostrophes (‘nothing really matters to me’, Tchaikovsky’s, Doesn’t / doesn’t in composing Q2), en dashes (bars 1–26, bars 1–6, and the em dashes in IV—V—I etc. at 450 dpi), Hommage à Horowitz, the spacing in "No.1" / "No. 1" / "No.78", "No. 78" (Ordinary prints the space), accents (Neainsín Bhán), and the case of every title and of PREPARATORY WORK (full capitals, regular weight). Cross-checked the words against the text layer (which drops "ti"/"ft" ligatures and the superscripts but is otherwise sound). Typed the printed text of every in-scope field into a script (lead-in bullets as "\n• ", " • " only between printed bullet lines, a space for unbulleted lines, tick boxes as "□ ") and compared each file string exactly after collapsing runs of spaces; checked the code point of every non-ASCII character in the file strings. Elective asks and composing grid stems were outside the brief and are not recorded (the composing stems "Answer one question only in this section: Q1 or Q2 or Q3." / "...: Q4 or Q5 or Q6." match the print). The file has no readFromPage entries.
